```{r}
# marginaleffects settings
options(marginaleffects_posterior_interval = "hdi")
options(marginaleffects_posterior_center = stats::median)
```

```{r}
probability_direction <- function(obj, id = "contrast", by = NULL) {
  # Extract posterior draws from marginaleffects object and compute pd per contrast
  # pd = proportion of draws consistent with the direction of the point estimate
  posterior_draws(obj) |>
    group_by(across(all_of(c(id, by)))) |>
    summarise(
      # mean(draw > 0) gives P(effect > 0); pd takes the larger of P(>0) and P(<0)
      pd = (\(p) max(p, 1 - p))(mean(draw > 0)),
      .groups = "drop"
    )
}
```

```{r}
hdi_excludes_zero <- function(x, cred = 0.95) {
  # Whether the 95% HDI excludes zero, using the shortest interval containing 95% of the draws.
  # This is the HDI algorithm marginaleffects uses for the tables; ggdist::median_hdi() estimates
  # the HDI from a smoothed density instead, which can differ in the third decimal
  x <- sort(x)
  n <- length(x)
  k <- n - floor(n * cred)
  i <- which.min(x[(n - k + 1):n] - x[1:k])
  if_else(sign(x[i]) == sign(x[n - k + i]), "Excludes zero", "Includes zero")
}
```

### Tables

#### RQ1.1 Model Summary Table

```{r}
rq1.1.1_brms <- tidy(rq1.1.1, robust = TRUE, conf.method	= "HPDinterval", rhat = TRUE, ess = TRUE) |> 
  mutate(Model = "Overall")
rq1.1.2_brms <- tidy(rq1.1.2, robust = TRUE, conf.method	= "HPDinterval", rhat = TRUE, ess = TRUE) |> 
  mutate(Model = "Age Group")
rq1.1.3_brms <- tidy(rq1.1.3, robust = TRUE, conf.method	= "HPDinterval", rhat = TRUE, ess = TRUE) |> 
  mutate(Model = "Gender")
rq1.1.8_brms <- tidy(rq1.1.8, robust = TRUE, conf.method	= "HPDinterval", rhat = TRUE, ess = TRUE) |> 
  mutate(Model = "Living Standard")

rq1.1_brms <- bind_rows(rq1.1.1_brms, rq1.1.2_brms, rq1.1.3_brms, rq1.1.8_brms) |> 
  filter(effect == "fixed") |> 
  mutate(term = case_when(
    term == "(Intercept)" ~ "Intercept",
    term == "exp_conditionhope" ~ "Hope (vs. Control)",
    term == "exp_conditionanxiety" ~ "Anxiety (vs. Control)",
    term == "age_group22M26years" ~ "Age Group 22-26 (vs. 16-21)",
    term == "exp_conditionhope:age_group22M26years" ~ "Age Group x Hope",
    term == "exp_conditionanxiety:age_group22M26years" ~ "Age Group x Anxiety",
    term == "genderfemale" ~ "Women (vs. Men)",
    term == "genderother" ~ "Other (vs. Men)",
    term == "exp_conditionhope:genderfemale" ~ "Women x Hope",    
    term == "exp_conditionanxiety:genderfemale" ~ "Women x Anxiety",   
    term == "exp_conditionhope:genderother" ~ "Other x Hope",    
    term == "exp_conditionanxiety:genderother" ~ "Other x Anxiety",   
    term == "living_standardCoping" ~ "Coping (vs. Difficult)",
    term == "living_standardComfortable" ~ "Comfortable (vs. Difficult)",
    term == "exp_conditionhope:living_standardCoping" ~ "Coping x Hope",
    term == "exp_conditionanxiety:living_standardCoping" ~ "Coping x Anxiety",
    term == "exp_conditionhope:living_standardComfortable" ~ "Comfortable x Hope",
    term == "exp_conditionanxiety:living_standardComfortable" ~ "Comfortable x Anxiety",
    TRUE ~ term  
  )) |> 
  select(Term = term, 
         Median = estimate, 
         MAD = std.error, 
         "95% HDI Lower" = conf.low,
         "95% HDI Upper" = conf.high,
         "R-hat" = rhat,
         ESS = ess, 
         Model
         )

n1 <- rq1.1_brms |> filter(Model == "Overall") |> nrow()
n2 <- rq1.1_brms |> filter(Model == "Age Group") |> nrow()
n3 <- rq1.1_brms |> filter(Model == "Gender") |> nrow()
```

```{r}
rq1.1_brms_table <- rq1.1_brms |> 
  mutate(across(where(is.numeric), ~round(.x, 3))) |> 
  select(-Model) |> 
  tt() |> 
  group_tt(i = list(
    "Main Model" = 1,
    "Interaction with Age Group" = n1 + 1,
    "Interaction with Gender" = n1 + n2 + 1,
    "Interaction with Living Standard" = n1 + n2 + n3 + 1
  ))

rq1.1_brms_table

rq1.1_brms_table |> 
  save_tt(here(table_dir, "RQ1", "RQ1.1_brms_table.docx"), overwrite = TRUE)
```

#### RQ1.1 Comparisons Table

```{r}
rq1.1.1_comp_raw <- avg_comparisons(rq1.1.1, variables = list(exp_condition = "pairwise"))
rq1.1.2_comp_raw <- avg_comparisons(rq1.1.2, variables = list(exp_condition = "pairwise"), by = "age_group")
rq1.1.3_comp_raw <- avg_comparisons(rq1.1.3, variables = list(exp_condition = "pairwise"), by = "gender")
rq1.1.8_comp_raw <- avg_comparisons(rq1.1.8, variables = list(exp_condition = "pairwise"), by = "living_standard")

rq1.1.1_comp <- rq1.1.1_comp_raw |>
  as_tibble() |>
  left_join(probability_direction(rq1.1.1_comp_raw), by = "contrast") |>
  mutate(Model = "Overall", Group = "Overall")

rq1.1.2_comp <- rq1.1.2_comp_raw |>
  as_tibble() |>
  left_join(probability_direction(rq1.1.2_comp_raw, by = "age_group"), by = c("contrast", "age_group")) |>
  mutate(Model = "Age Group") |>
  rename(Group = age_group)

rq1.1.3_comp <- rq1.1.3_comp_raw |>
  as_tibble() |>
  left_join(probability_direction(rq1.1.3_comp_raw, by = "gender"), by = c("contrast", "gender")) |>
  mutate(Model = "Gender") |>
  rename(Group = gender)

rq1.1.8_comp <- rq1.1.8_comp_raw |>
  as_tibble() |>
  left_join(probability_direction(rq1.1.8_comp_raw, by = "living_standard"), by = c("contrast", "living_standard")) |>
  mutate(Model = "Living Standard") |>
  rename(Group = living_standard)

rq1.1_comp <- bind_rows(rq1.1.1_comp, rq1.1.2_comp, rq1.1.3_comp, rq1.1.8_comp) |>
  mutate(
    Contrast = case_when(
      contrast == "anxiety - control" ~ "Anxiety - Control",
      contrast == "anxiety - hope"    ~ "Anxiety - Hope",
      contrast == "hope - control"    ~ "Hope - Control"),
    Group = case_when(
      Group == "male"   ~ "Men",
      Group == "female" ~ "Women",
      Group == "other"  ~ "Other",
      TRUE ~ Group
    )) |>
  select(Model, Group, Contrast,
         Median = estimate,
         "95% HDI Lower" = conf.low,
         "95% HDI Upper" = conf.high,
         "Probability of Direction" = pd)

n1 <- rq1.1_comp |> filter(Model == "Overall") |> nrow()
n2 <- rq1.1_comp |> filter(Model == "Age Group") |> nrow()
n3 <- rq1.1_comp |> filter(Model == "Gender") |> nrow()
```

```{r}
rq1.1_comp_table <- rq1.1_comp |> 
  mutate(across(where(is.numeric), ~round(.x, 3))) |> 
  select(-Model) |> 
  tt() |> 
  group_tt(i = list(
    "Main Model" = 1,
    "By Age Group" = n1 + 1,
    "By Gender" = n1 + n2 + 1,
    "By Living Standard" = n1 + n2 + n3 + 1
  ))

rq1.1_comp_table

rq1.1_comp_table |> 
  save_tt(here(table_dir, "RQ1", "RQ1.1_comp_table.docx"), overwrite = TRUE)
```

### Figures

#### Figure Data

```{r}
# Overall ATE
rq1.1.1.draws <- expand.grid(
  exp_condition = c("control", "anxiety", "hope")
) |>
  add_epred_draws(rq1.1.1, re_formula = NA) |>
  ungroup()

rq1.1.1.contrasts <- rq1.1.1.draws |>
  select(exp_condition, .draw, .epred) |>
  pivot_wider(names_from = exp_condition, values_from = .epred) |>
  mutate(
    `Anxiety - Control` = anxiety - control,
    `Hope - Control` = hope - control,
    `Anxiety - Hope` = anxiety - hope
  ) |>
  pivot_longer(
    cols = c(`Anxiety - Control`, `Hope - Control`, `Anxiety - Hope`),
    names_to = "contrast",
    values_to = "estimate"
  ) |>
  mutate(
    model = "ATE",
    subgroup = "ATE"
  )

# cATE by age_group
rq1.1.2.draws <- expand.grid(
  exp_condition = c("control", "anxiety", "hope"),
  age_group = unique(df$age_group)
  ) |>
  add_epred_draws(rq1.1.2, re_formula = NA) |>
  ungroup()

rq1.1.2.contrasts <- rq1.1.2.draws |>
  select(exp_condition, age_group, .draw, .epred) |>
  pivot_wider(names_from = exp_condition, values_from = .epred) |>
  mutate(
    `Anxiety - Control` = anxiety - control,
    `Hope - Control` = hope - control,
    `Anxiety - Hope` = anxiety - hope
  ) |>
  pivot_longer(
    cols = c(`Anxiety - Control`, `Hope - Control`, `Anxiety - Hope`),
    names_to = "contrast",
    values_to = "estimate"
  ) |>
  mutate(
    model = "Age",
    subgroup = as.character(age_group)
  ) |>
  select(-age_group)

# cATE by gender
rq1.1.3.draws <- expand.grid(
  exp_condition = c("control", "anxiety", "hope"),
  gender = unique(df$gender)
) |>
  add_epred_draws(rq1.1.3, re_formula = NA) |>
  ungroup() |> 
  filter(gender != "other")

rq1.1.3.contrasts <- rq1.1.3.draws |>
  select(exp_condition, gender, .draw, .epred) |>
  pivot_wider(names_from = exp_condition, values_from = .epred) |>
  mutate(
    `Anxiety - Control` = anxiety - control,
    `Hope - Control` = hope - control,
    `Anxiety - Hope` = anxiety - hope
  ) |>
  pivot_longer(
    cols = c(`Anxiety - Control`, `Hope - Control`, `Anxiety - Hope`),
    names_to = "contrast",
    values_to = "estimate"
  ) |>
  mutate(
    model = "Gender",
    subgroup = as.character(gender)
  ) |>
  select(-gender)

# cATE by living standard
rq1.1.8.draws <- expand.grid(
  exp_condition = c("control", "anxiety", "hope"),
  living_standard = levels(rq1.1.8$data$living_standard)
) |>
  add_epred_draws(rq1.1.8, re_formula = NA) |>
  ungroup()

rq1.1.8.contrasts <- rq1.1.8.draws |>
  select(exp_condition, living_standard, .draw, .epred) |>
  pivot_wider(names_from = exp_condition, values_from = .epred) |>
  mutate(
    `Anxiety - Control` = anxiety - control,
    `Hope - Control` = hope - control,
    `Anxiety - Hope` = anxiety - hope
  ) |>
  pivot_longer(
    cols = c(`Anxiety - Control`, `Hope - Control`, `Anxiety - Hope`),
    names_to = "contrast",
    values_to = "estimate"
  ) |>
  mutate(
    model = "Living Standard",
    subgroup = as.character(living_standard)
  ) |>
  select(-living_standard)

rq1.1_posterior_data <- bind_rows(rq1.1.1.contrasts, rq1.1.2.contrasts, rq1.1.3.contrasts, rq1.1.8.contrasts) |>
  mutate(
    contrast = factor(contrast, levels = c("Anxiety - Hope", "Anxiety - Control", "Hope - Control")),
    model = factor(model, levels = c("ATE", "Age", "Gender", "Living Standard"))
  )

# Compute whether HDI excludes zero for each group
rq1.1_hdi_check <- rq1.1_posterior_data |>
  mutate(
    subgroup = case_when(
      subgroup == "male" ~ "Men",
      subgroup == "female" ~ "Women",
      subgroup == "16-21 years" ~ "16-21",
      subgroup == "22-26 years" ~ "22-26",
      TRUE ~ subgroup
    ),
    subgroup = factor(subgroup, levels = c("ATE", "22-26", "16-21", "Women", "Men",
                                           "Comfortable", "Coping", "Difficult"))
  ) |>
  group_by(model, contrast, subgroup) |>
  summarise(excludes_zero = hdi_excludes_zero(estimate), .groups = "drop")
```

#### RQ1.1 Figure

```{r}
#| fig-height: 7
#| fig-width: 8

rq1.1_posterior_data |>
  mutate(
    estimate = estimate * 100,
    subgroup = case_when(
      subgroup == "male" ~ "Men",
      subgroup == "female" ~ "Women",
      subgroup == "16-21 years" ~ "16-21",
      subgroup == "22-26 years" ~ "22-26",
      TRUE ~ subgroup
    ),
    subgroup = factor(subgroup, levels = c("ATE", "22-26", "16-21", "Women", "Men",
                                           "Comfortable", "Coping", "Difficult"))
  ) |>
  left_join(rq1.1_hdi_check, by = c("model", "contrast", "subgroup")) |>
  ggplot(aes(x = estimate, y = subgroup, fill = excludes_zero)) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "gray40", linewidth = 0.6) +
  stat_slabinterval(
    .width = c(.95),
    point_interval = "median_hdi",
    scale = 0.7,
    slab_alpha = 0.6,        
    interval_alpha = 1,      
    point_alpha = 1,          
    normalize = "groups",
    point_size = 2.5,
    interval_size = 1.5) +
  facet_grid(model ~ contrast, scales = "free_y", space = "free_y") +
  scale_fill_manual(
    values = c("Excludes zero" = "#364B9A", "Includes zero" = "#4A7BB7"),
    name = "95% HDI",
  ) +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = seq(-10, 10, by = 5), expand = expansion(add = 2.5)) +
  coord_cartesian(xlim = c(-10, 10)) +
  labs(
    x = "Percentage Points",
    y = NULL,
    title = "Effects on Democratic Support",
    subtitle = "Posterior Distributions with Median and 95% HDI"
  ) +
  theme_allround() +
  theme(
    legend.position = "bottom",
    panel.grid.major.x = element_line(color = "grey90", linewidth = 0.2)
  ) 

ggsave(here(figure_dir, "RQ1", "RQ1.1_figure.svg"), height = 7, width = 8, web_fonts = falo_svg_fonts())
```

#### RQ1.1 Item-Level Differences Figure

```{r}
df_dem_items <- df |> 
  select(id, exp_condition, 
         exp_dem_censor_media_rev,
         exp_dem_one_party_rev,
         exp_dem_question_vote_rev,
         exp_dem_respect_elections,
         exp_dem_ignore_courts_rev,
         exp_dem_ignore_parliament_rev,
         exp_dem_bend_law_rev) |> 
  pivot_longer(
    cols = exp_dem_censor_media_rev:exp_dem_bend_law_rev,
    names_to = "item",
    values_to = "response"
  ) |> 
  mutate(
    response_pomp = (response - 1) / (5 - 1),  # Convert 1-5 to 0-1
    item = factor(item, 
                  levels = c("exp_dem_censor_media_rev",
                            "exp_dem_one_party_rev",
                            "exp_dem_question_vote_rev",
                            "exp_dem_respect_elections",
                            "exp_dem_ignore_courts_rev",
                            "exp_dem_ignore_parliament_rev",
                            "exp_dem_bend_law_rev"),
                  labels = c("FreeExp", "FreeAssc", "UniSuff", 
                            "FFElect", "JudCnstr", "LegCnstr", "EqLaw"))
  )

# Get posterior predictions 
rq1.1.7.draws <- expand.grid(
  exp_condition = c("control", "anxiety", "hope"),
  item = levels(df_dem_items$item)) |>
  add_epred_draws(rq1.1.7, re_formula = NA) |>
  ungroup()

# Compute item-level pairwise contrasts 
rq1.1.7.item_contrasts <- rq1.1.7.draws |>
  select(exp_condition, item, .draw, .epred) |>
  pivot_wider(names_from = exp_condition, values_from = .epred) |>
  mutate(
    `Anxiety - Control` = anxiety - control,
    `Hope - Control` = hope - control,
    `Anxiety - Hope` = anxiety - hope
  ) |>
  pivot_longer(
    cols = c(`Anxiety - Control`, `Hope - Control`, `Anxiety - Hope`),
    names_to = "contrast",
    values_to = "estimate"
  ) |>
  mutate(type = "Item-level")

# Compute pairwise comparisons across items
rq1.1.7.avg_contrasts <- rq1.1.7.item_contrasts |>
  group_by(contrast, .draw) |>
  summarise(estimate = mean(estimate), .groups = "drop") |>
  mutate(
    item = "Overall ATE",
    type = "Overall"
  )

# Combine draws
rq1.1.7.contrasts <- bind_rows(rq1.1.7.item_contrasts, rq1.1.7.avg_contrasts) |>
  mutate(
    item = factor(item, levels = c(levels(df_dem_items$item), "Overall ATE")),
    contrast = factor(contrast, levels = c("Anxiety - Hope", "Anxiety - Control", "Hope - Control"))
  )

# Compute whether HDI excludes zero for each item
rq1.1.7.hdi_check <- rq1.1.7.contrasts |>
  mutate(estimate = estimate * 100) |>
  group_by(item, contrast) |>
  summarise(excludes_zero = hdi_excludes_zero(estimate), .groups = "drop")
```

### Tables

#### RQ1.2 Model Summary Table

```{r}
conjoint_controls <- c(
  "b_conjoint_sexFemale", "b_conjoint_age_z",
  "b_conjoint_partyConservatives", "b_conjoint_partyLiberalDemocrats",
  "b_conjoint_partyGreenParty", "b_conjoint_partyReformUK",
  "b_conjoint_ecoEconomicallygood", "b_conjoint_ecoEconomicallybad",
  "prior_b"
)

rq1.2.1_brms <- bind_rows(
  tidy(rq1.2.1, parameters = "b",    robust = TRUE, conf.method = "HPDinterval", rhat = TRUE, ess = TRUE),
  tidy(rq1.2.1, parameters = "^sd_", robust = TRUE, conf.method = "HPDinterval", rhat = TRUE, ess = TRUE)
) |> mutate(Model = "Overall")

rq1.2.2_brms <- bind_rows(
  tidy(rq1.2.2, parameters = "b",    robust = TRUE, conf.method = "HPDinterval", rhat = TRUE, ess = TRUE),
  tidy(rq1.2.2, parameters = "^sd_", robust = TRUE, conf.method = "HPDinterval", rhat = TRUE, ess = TRUE)
) |> mutate(Model = "Age Group")

rq1.2.3_brms <- bind_rows(
  tidy(rq1.2.3, parameters = "b",    robust = TRUE, conf.method = "HPDinterval", rhat = TRUE, ess = TRUE),
  tidy(rq1.2.3, parameters = "^sd_", robust = TRUE, conf.method = "HPDinterval", rhat = TRUE, ess = TRUE)
) |> mutate(Model = "Gender")

rq1.2.8_brms <- bind_rows(
  tidy(rq1.2.8, parameters = "b",    robust = TRUE, conf.method = "HPDinterval", rhat = TRUE, ess = TRUE),
  tidy(rq1.2.8, parameters = "^sd_", robust = TRUE, conf.method = "HPDinterval", rhat = TRUE, ess = TRUE)
) |> mutate(Model = "Living Standard")

rq1.2_brms <- bind_rows(rq1.2.1_brms, rq1.2.2_brms, rq1.2.3_brms, rq1.2.8_brms) |>
  filter(!term %in% conjoint_controls) |>
  mutate(term = str_remove(term, "^b_")) |>
  mutate(term = case_when(
    term == "(Intercept)"                                                      ~ "Intercept",
    term == "conjoint_demDemocratic"                                           ~ "Democratic (vs. Undemocratic)",
    term == "exp_conditionhope"                                                ~ "Hope (vs. Control)",
    term == "exp_conditionanxiety"                                             ~ "Anxiety (vs. Control)",
    term == "conjoint_demDemocratic:exp_conditionhope"                         ~ "Democratic × Hope",
    term == "conjoint_demDemocratic:exp_conditionanxiety"                      ~ "Democratic × Anxiety",
    term == "sd_id__(Intercept)"                                               ~ "SD(Intercept)",
    term == "age_group22M26years"                                              ~ "Age Group 22-26 (vs. 16-21)",
    term == "conjoint_demDemocratic:age_group22M26years"                       ~ "Democratic × Age Group",
    term == "exp_conditionhope:age_group22M26years"                            ~ "Age Group × Hope",
    term == "exp_conditionanxiety:age_group22M26years"                         ~ "Age Group × Anxiety",
    term == "conjoint_demDemocratic:exp_conditionhope:age_group22M26years"     ~ "Democratic × Hope × Age Group",
    term == "conjoint_demDemocratic:exp_conditionanxiety:age_group22M26years"  ~ "Democratic × Anxiety × Age Group",
    term == "genderfemale"                                                     ~ "Women (vs. Men)",
    term == "genderother"                                                      ~ "Other (vs. Men)",
    term == "conjoint_demDemocratic:genderfemale"                              ~ "Democratic × Women",
    term == "conjoint_demDemocratic:genderother"                               ~ "Democratic × Other",
    term == "exp_conditionhope:genderfemale"                                   ~ "Women × Hope",
    term == "exp_conditionanxiety:genderfemale"                                ~ "Women × Anxiety",
    term == "exp_conditionhope:genderother"                                    ~ "Other × Hope",
    term == "exp_conditionanxiety:genderother"                                 ~ "Other × Anxiety",
    term == "conjoint_demDemocratic:exp_conditionhope:genderfemale"            ~ "Democratic × Hope × Women",
    term == "conjoint_demDemocratic:exp_conditionanxiety:genderfemale"         ~ "Democratic × Anxiety × Women",
    term == "conjoint_demDemocratic:exp_conditionhope:genderother"             ~ "Democratic × Hope × Other",
    term == "conjoint_demDemocratic:exp_conditionanxiety:genderother"          ~ "Democratic × Anxiety × Other",
    term == "living_standardCoping"                                            ~ "Coping (vs. Difficult)",
    term == "living_standardComfortable"                                       ~ "Comfortable (vs. Difficult)",
    term == "conjoint_demDemocratic:living_standardCoping"                     ~ "Democratic × Coping",
    term == "conjoint_demDemocratic:living_standardComfortable"                ~ "Democratic × Comfortable",
    term == "exp_conditionhope:living_standardCoping"                          ~ "Coping × Hope",
    term == "exp_conditionanxiety:living_standardCoping"                       ~ "Coping × Anxiety",
    term == "exp_conditionhope:living_standardComfortable"                     ~ "Comfortable × Hope",
    term == "exp_conditionanxiety:living_standardComfortable"                  ~ "Comfortable × Anxiety",
    term == "conjoint_demDemocratic:exp_conditionhope:living_standardCoping"         ~ "Democratic × Hope × Coping",
    term == "conjoint_demDemocratic:exp_conditionanxiety:living_standardCoping"      ~ "Democratic × Anxiety × Coping",
    term == "conjoint_demDemocratic:exp_conditionhope:living_standardComfortable"    ~ "Democratic × Hope × Comfortable",
    term == "conjoint_demDemocratic:exp_conditionanxiety:living_standardComfortable" ~ "Democratic × Anxiety × Comfortable",
    TRUE ~ term
  )) |>
  select(Term = term, Median = estimate, MAD = std.error,
         "95% HDI Lower" = conf.low, "95% HDI Upper" = conf.high,
         "R-hat" = rhat, ESS = ess, Model)

n1 <- rq1.2_brms |> filter(Model == "Overall") |> nrow()
n2 <- rq1.2_brms |> filter(Model == "Age Group") |> nrow()
n3 <- rq1.2_brms |> filter(Model == "Gender") |> nrow()
```

```{r}
rq1.2_brms_table <- rq1.2_brms |>
  mutate(across(where(is.numeric), ~round(.x, 3))) |>
  select(-Model) |>
  tt(notes = "Note. All models control for conjoint attributes: candidate sex, age, political party, and economic reputation.") |>
  group_tt(i = list(
    "Main Model" = 1,
    "Interaction with Age Group" = n1 + 1,
    "Interaction with Gender" = n1 + n2 + 1,
    "Interaction with Living Standard" = n1 + n2 + n3 + 1
  ))

rq1.2_brms_table
rq1.2_brms_table |>
  save_tt(here(table_dir, "RQ1", "RQ1.2_brms_table.docx"), overwrite = TRUE)
```

#### RQ1.2 Comparisons Table

```{r}
rq1.2.1_comp_raw <- avg_comparisons(rq1.2.1, variables = list(conjoint_dem = "pairwise"), by = "exp_condition", hypothesis = ~pairwise)
rq1.2.2_comp_raw <- avg_comparisons(rq1.2.2, variables = list(conjoint_dem = "pairwise"), by = c("exp_condition", "age_group"), hypothesis = ~pairwise)
rq1.2.3_comp_raw <- avg_comparisons(rq1.2.3, variables = list(conjoint_dem = "pairwise"), by = c("exp_condition", "gender"), hypothesis = ~pairwise)
rq1.2.8_comp_raw <- avg_comparisons(rq1.2.8, variables = list(conjoint_dem = "pairwise"), by = c("exp_condition", "living_standard"), hypothesis = ~pairwise)

within_age <- c(
  "(hope 16-21 years) - (control 16-21 years)",
  "(anxiety 16-21 years) - (control 16-21 years)",
  "(anxiety 16-21 years) - (hope 16-21 years)",
  "(hope 22-26 years) - (control 22-26 years)",
  "(anxiety 22-26 years) - (control 22-26 years)",
  "(anxiety 22-26 years) - (hope 22-26 years)"
)

within_gender <- c(
  "(hope male) - (control male)",
  "(anxiety male) - (control male)",
  "(anxiety male) - (hope male)",
  "(hope female) - (control female)",
  "(anxiety female) - (control female)",
  "(anxiety female) - (hope female)",
  "(hope other) - (control other)",
  "(anxiety other) - (control other)",
  "(anxiety other) - (hope other)"
)

within_living_standard <- c(
  "(hope Difficult) - (control Difficult)",
  "(anxiety Difficult) - (control Difficult)",
  "(anxiety Difficult) - (hope Difficult)",
  "(hope Coping) - (control Coping)",
  "(anxiety Coping) - (control Coping)",
  "(anxiety Coping) - (hope Coping)",
  "(hope Comfortable) - (control Comfortable)",
  "(anxiety Comfortable) - (control Comfortable)",
  "(anxiety Comfortable) - (hope Comfortable)"
)

rq1.2.1_comp <- rq1.2.1_comp_raw |>
  as_tibble() |>
  left_join(probability_direction(rq1.2.1_comp_raw, id = "hypothesis"), by = "hypothesis") |>
  mutate(Model = "Overall", Group = "Overall")

rq1.2.2_comp <- rq1.2.2_comp_raw |>
  as_tibble() |>
  filter(hypothesis %in% within_age) |>
  left_join(
    posterior_draws(rq1.2.2_comp_raw) |>
      filter(hypothesis %in% within_age) |>
      group_by(hypothesis) |>
      summarise(pd = (\(p) max(p, 1 - p))(mean(draw > 0)), .groups = "drop"),
    by = "hypothesis"
  ) |>
  mutate(
    Model = "Age Group",
    Group = case_when(
      str_detect(hypothesis, "16-21") ~ "16-21 years",
      str_detect(hypothesis, "22-26") ~ "22-26 years"
    )
  )

rq1.2.3_comp <- rq1.2.3_comp_raw |>
  as_tibble() |>
  filter(hypothesis %in% within_gender) |>
  left_join(
    posterior_draws(rq1.2.3_comp_raw) |>
      filter(hypothesis %in% within_gender) |>
      group_by(hypothesis) |>
      summarise(pd = (\(p) max(p, 1 - p))(mean(draw > 0)), .groups = "drop"),
    by = "hypothesis"
  ) |>
  mutate(
    Model = "Gender",
    Group = case_when(
      str_detect(hypothesis, "female") ~ "Women",
      str_detect(hypothesis, "male")   ~ "Men",
      str_detect(hypothesis, "other")  ~ "Other")
  )

rq1.2.8_comp <- rq1.2.8_comp_raw |>
  as_tibble() |>
  filter(hypothesis %in% within_living_standard) |>
  left_join(
    posterior_draws(rq1.2.8_comp_raw) |>
      filter(hypothesis %in% within_living_standard) |>
      group_by(hypothesis) |>
      summarise(pd = (\(p) max(p, 1 - p))(mean(draw > 0)), .groups = "drop"),
    by = "hypothesis"
  ) |>
  mutate(
    Model = "Living Standard",
    Group = case_when(
      str_detect(hypothesis, "Difficult")   ~ "Difficult",
      str_detect(hypothesis, "Coping")      ~ "Coping",
      str_detect(hypothesis, "Comfortable") ~ "Comfortable")
  )

rq1.2_comp <- bind_rows(rq1.2.1_comp, rq1.2.2_comp, rq1.2.3_comp, rq1.2.8_comp) |>
  mutate(Contrast = case_when(
    str_detect(hypothesis, "^\\(hope")    & str_detect(hypothesis, "control") ~ "Hope - Control",
    str_detect(hypothesis, "^\\(anxiety") & str_detect(hypothesis, "control") ~ "Anxiety - Control",
    str_detect(hypothesis, "^\\(anxiety") & str_detect(hypothesis, "hope")    ~ "Anxiety - Hope"
  )) |>
  select(Model, Group, Contrast,
         Median = estimate,
         "95% HDI Lower" = conf.low,
         "95% HDI Upper" = conf.high,
         "Probability of Direction" = pd)

n1 <- rq1.2_comp |> filter(Model == "Overall") |> nrow()
n2 <- rq1.2_comp |> filter(Model == "Age Group") |> nrow()
n3 <- rq1.2_comp |> filter(Model == "Gender") |> nrow()
```

```{r}
rq1.2_comp_table <- rq1.2_comp |>
  mutate(across(where(is.numeric), ~round(.x, 3))) |>
  select(-Model) |>
  tt() |>
  group_tt(i = list(
    "Main Model" = 1,
    "By Age Group" = n1 + 1,
    "By Gender" = n1 + n2 + 1,
    "By Living Standard" = n1 + n2 + n3 + 1
  ))

rq1.2_comp_table
rq1.2_comp_table |>
  save_tt(here(table_dir, "RQ1", "RQ1.2_comp_table.docx"), overwrite = TRUE)
```

### Figures

#### Figure Data

```{r}
rq1.2.1.cAMCEs <- avg_slopes(rq1.2.1, variables = "conjoint_dem", by = "exp_condition", re_formula = NA) |>
  posterior_draws()

rq1.2.1.contrasts <- rq1.2.1.cAMCEs |>
  select(drawid, exp_condition, draw) |>
  pivot_wider(names_from = exp_condition, values_from = draw) |>
  mutate(
    `Anxiety - Control` = anxiety - control,
    `Hope - Control`    = hope - control,
    `Anxiety - Hope`    = anxiety - hope
  ) |>
  pivot_longer(
    cols = c(`Anxiety - Control`, `Hope - Control`, `Anxiety - Hope`),
    names_to = "contrast",
    values_to = "estimate"
  ) |>
  mutate(model = "ATE", subgroup = "ATE")

rq1.2.2.cAMCEs <- avg_slopes(rq1.2.2, variables = "conjoint_dem", by = c("exp_condition", "age_group"), re_formula = NA) |>
  posterior_draws()

rq1.2.2.contrasts <- rq1.2.2.cAMCEs |>
  select(drawid, exp_condition, age_group, draw) |>
  pivot_wider(names_from = exp_condition, values_from = draw) |>
  mutate(
    `Anxiety - Control` = anxiety - control,
    `Hope - Control`    = hope - control,
    `Anxiety - Hope`    = anxiety - hope
  ) |>
  pivot_longer(
    cols = c(`Anxiety - Control`, `Hope - Control`, `Anxiety - Hope`),
    names_to = "contrast",
    values_to = "estimate"
  ) |>
  mutate(model = "Age", subgroup = as.character(age_group)) |>
  select(-age_group)

rq1.2.3.cAMCEs <- avg_slopes(rq1.2.3, variables = "conjoint_dem", by = c("exp_condition", "gender"), re_formula = NA) |>
  posterior_draws()

rq1.2.3.contrasts <- rq1.2.3.cAMCEs |>
  select(drawid, exp_condition, gender, draw) |>
  pivot_wider(names_from = exp_condition, values_from = draw) |>
  mutate(
    `Anxiety - Control` = anxiety - control,
    `Hope - Control`    = hope - control,
    `Anxiety - Hope`    = anxiety - hope
  ) |>
  pivot_longer(
    cols = c(`Anxiety - Control`, `Hope - Control`, `Anxiety - Hope`),
    names_to = "contrast",
    values_to = "estimate"
  ) |>
  mutate(model = "Gender", subgroup = as.character(gender)) |>
  select(-gender)

rq1.2.8.cAMCEs <- avg_slopes(rq1.2.8, variables = "conjoint_dem", by = c("exp_condition", "living_standard"), re_formula = NA) |>
  posterior_draws()

rq1.2.8.contrasts <- rq1.2.8.cAMCEs |>
  select(drawid, exp_condition, living_standard, draw) |>
  pivot_wider(names_from = exp_condition, values_from = draw) |>
  mutate(
    `Anxiety - Control` = anxiety - control,
    `Hope - Control`    = hope - control,
    `Anxiety - Hope`    = anxiety - hope
  ) |>
  pivot_longer(
    cols = c(`Anxiety - Control`, `Hope - Control`, `Anxiety - Hope`),
    names_to = "contrast",
    values_to = "estimate"
  ) |>
  mutate(model = "Living Standard", subgroup = as.character(living_standard)) |>
  select(-living_standard)

rq1.2_posterior_data <- bind_rows(rq1.2.1.contrasts, rq1.2.2.contrasts, rq1.2.3.contrasts, rq1.2.8.contrasts) |>
  filter(subgroup != "other") |>
  mutate(
    subgroup = case_when(
      subgroup == "male"       ~ "Men",
      subgroup == "female"     ~ "Women",
      subgroup == "16-21 years" ~ "16-21",
      subgroup == "22-26 years" ~ "22-26",
      TRUE ~ subgroup
    ),
    contrast = factor(contrast, levels = c("Anxiety - Hope", "Anxiety - Control", "Hope - Control")),
    model    = factor(model, levels = c("ATE", "Age", "Gender", "Living Standard")),
    subgroup = factor(subgroup, levels = c("ATE", "22-26", "16-21", "Women", "Men",
                                           "Comfortable", "Coping", "Difficult"))
  )

rq1.2_hdi_check <- rq1.2_posterior_data |>
  group_by(model, contrast, subgroup) |>
  summarise(excludes_zero = hdi_excludes_zero(estimate), .groups = "drop")
```

#### RQ1.2 Figure

```{r}
#| fig-height: 7
#| fig-width: 8

rq1.2_posterior_data |>
  mutate(estimate = estimate * 100) |>
  left_join(rq1.2_hdi_check, by = c("model", "contrast", "subgroup")) |>
  ggplot(aes(x = estimate, y = subgroup, fill = excludes_zero)) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "gray40", linewidth = 0.6) +
  stat_slabinterval(
    .width = c(.95),
    point_interval = "median_hdi",
    scale = 0.7,
    slab_alpha = 0.6,
    interval_alpha = 1,
    point_alpha = 1,
    normalize = "groups",
    point_size = 2.5,
    interval_size = 1.5
  ) +
  facet_grid(model ~ contrast, scales = "free_y", space = "free_y") +
  scale_fill_manual(
    values = c("Excludes zero" = "#364B9A", "Includes zero" = "#4A7BB7"),
    name = "95% HDI"
  ) +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = seq(-15, 15, by = 5), expand = expansion(add = 0.5)) +
  coord_cartesian(xlim = c(-20, 20)) +
  labs(
    x = "Percentage Points",
    y = NULL,
    title = "Effects on Democratic Candidate Preference",
    subtitle = "Posterior Distributions with Median and 95% HDI"
  ) +
  theme_allround() +
  theme(
    legend.position = "bottom",
    panel.grid.major.x = element_line(color = "grey90", linewidth = 0.2)
  )

ggsave(here(figure_dir, "RQ1", "RQ1.2_figure.svg"), height = 7, width = 8, web_fonts = falo_svg_fonts())
```

### Party Marginal Means

Marginal means of party by condition from the party model in 06_conjoint_candidate_models.

```{r}
rq1.2.party <- readRDS(here(model_dir, "RQ1", "cj_party.rds"))

party_mm_raw <- avg_predictions(rq1.2.party, by = c("conjoint_party", "exp_condition"))
party_diff_raw <- avg_predictions(rq1.2.party, by = c("conjoint_party", "exp_condition"),
                                  hypothesis = difference ~ pairwise | conjoint_party)

party_mm <- party_mm_raw |>
  as_tibble() |>
  mutate(Block = "Marginal Means",
         Comparison = str_to_title(exp_condition),
         pd = NA_real_)

party_diff <- party_diff_raw |>
  as_tibble() |>
  left_join(probability_direction(party_diff_raw, id = "hypothesis", by = "conjoint_party"),
            by = c("hypothesis", "conjoint_party")) |>
  mutate(Block = "Differences Between Conditions",
         Comparison = hypothesis |> str_remove_all("[()]") |> str_to_title())

party_table_data <- bind_rows(party_mm, party_diff) |>
  select(Block,
         Party = conjoint_party,
         "Condition / Contrast" = Comparison,
         Median = estimate,
         "95% HDI Lower" = conf.low,
         "95% HDI Upper" = conf.high,
         "Probability of Direction" = pd)
```

```{r}
party_table <- party_table_data |>
  mutate(across(where(is.numeric), ~round(.x, 3)),
         # Probability of direction is only defined for the differences
         `Probability of Direction` = if_else(is.na(`Probability of Direction`), "",
                                              sprintf("%.3f", `Probability of Direction`))) |>
  select(-Block) |>
  tt(notes = paste("Note. Marginal means are the predicted probabilities of choosing a candidate of each party",
                   "in each condition, averaged over the other attributes (candidate sex, age, democratic behaviour,",
                   "and economic reputation), from a Bayesian logistic mixed-effects model with a party × condition",
                   "interaction. Differences between conditions are in probability units.")) |>
  group_tt(i = list(
    "Marginal Means" = 1,
    "Differences Between Conditions" = nrow(party_mm) + 1
  ))

party_table
party_table |>
  save_tt(here(table_dir, "RQ1", "RQ1.2_party_table.docx"), overwrite = TRUE)
```

```{r}
#| fig-height: 5

party_mm |>

  geom_pointrange(aes(xmin = conf.low, xmax = conf.high),

    y = NULL,
    title = "Marginal Means of Party by Condition",

ggsave(here(figure_dir, "RQ1", "RQ1.2_party_figure.svg"), height = 5, width = 7, web_fonts = falo_svg_fonts())
```

```{r}
rq2.1.1_brms <- tidy(rq2.1.1, robust = TRUE, conf.method	= "HPDinterval", rhat = TRUE, ess = TRUE) |> 
  mutate(Model = "Overall")
rq2.1.2_brms <- tidy(rq2.1.2, robust = TRUE, conf.method	= "HPDinterval", rhat = TRUE, ess = TRUE) |> 
  mutate(Model = "Age Group")
rq2.1.3_brms <- tidy(rq2.1.3, robust = TRUE, conf.method	= "HPDinterval", rhat = TRUE, ess = TRUE) |> 
  mutate(Model = "Gender")
rq2.1.8_brms <- tidy(rq2.1.8, robust = TRUE, conf.method	= "HPDinterval", rhat = TRUE, ess = TRUE) |> 
  mutate(Model = "Living Standard")

rq2.1_brms <- bind_rows(rq2.1.1_brms, rq2.1.2_brms, rq2.1.3_brms, rq2.1.8_brms) |> 
  filter(effect == "fixed") |> 
  mutate(term = case_when(
    term == "(Intercept)" ~ "Intercept",
    term == "exp_conditionhope" ~ "Hope (vs. Control)",
    term == "exp_conditionanxiety" ~ "Anxiety (vs. Control)",
    term == "age_group22M26years" ~ "Age Group 22-26 (vs. 16-21)",
    term == "exp_conditionhope:age_group22M26years" ~ "Age Group x Hope",
    term == "exp_conditionanxiety:age_group22M26years" ~ "Age Group x Anxiety",
    term == "genderfemale" ~ "Women (vs. Men)",
    term == "genderother" ~ "Other (vs. Men)",
    term == "exp_conditionhope:genderfemale" ~ "Women x Hope",    
    term == "exp_conditionanxiety:genderfemale" ~ "Women x Anxiety",   
    term == "exp_conditionhope:genderother" ~ "Other x Hope",    
    term == "exp_conditionanxiety:genderother" ~ "Other x Anxiety",   
    term == "living_standardCoping" ~ "Coping (vs. Difficult)",
    term == "living_standardComfortable" ~ "Comfortable (vs. Difficult)",
    term == "exp_conditionhope:living_standardCoping" ~ "Coping x Hope",
    term == "exp_conditionanxiety:living_standardCoping" ~ "Coping x Anxiety",
    term == "exp_conditionhope:living_standardComfortable" ~ "Comfortable x Hope",
    term == "exp_conditionanxiety:living_standardComfortable" ~ "Comfortable x Anxiety",
    TRUE ~ term  
  )) |> 
  select(Term = term, 
         Median = estimate, 
         MAD = std.error, 
         "95% HDI Lower" = conf.low,
         "95% HDI Upper" = conf.high,
         "R-hat" = rhat,
         ESS = ess, 
         Model
  )

n1 <- rq2.1_brms |> filter(Model == "Overall") |> nrow()
n2 <- rq2.1_brms |> filter(Model == "Age Group") |> nrow()
n3 <- rq2.1_brms |> filter(Model == "Gender") |> nrow()
```

```{r}
  ))
```

#### Figure Data

```{r}
# rq2.1.1: Overall ATE
rq2.1.1.draws <- expand.grid(
  exp_condition = c("control", "anxiety", "hope")
) |>
  add_epred_draws(rq2.1.1, re_formula = NA) |>
  ungroup()

rq2.1.1.contrasts <- rq2.1.1.draws |>
  select(exp_condition, .draw, .epred) |>
  pivot_wider(names_from = exp_condition, values_from = .epred) |>
  mutate(
    `Anxiety - Control` = anxiety - control,
    `Hope - Control` = hope - control,
    `Anxiety - Hope` = anxiety - hope
  ) |>
  pivot_longer(
    cols = c(`Anxiety - Control`, `Hope - Control`, `Anxiety - Hope`),
    names_to = "contrast",
    values_to = "estimate"
  ) |>
  mutate(
    model = "ATE",
    subgroup = "ATE"
  )

# rq2.1.2: cATE by age_group
rq2.1.2.draws <- expand.grid(
  exp_condition = c("control", "anxiety", "hope"),
  age_group = unique(df$age_group)
) |>
  add_epred_draws(rq2.1.2, re_formula = NA) |>
  ungroup()

rq2.1.2.contrasts <- rq2.1.2.draws |>
  select(exp_condition, age_group, .draw, .epred) |>
  pivot_wider(names_from = exp_condition, values_from = .epred) |>
  mutate(
    `Anxiety - Control` = anxiety - control,
    `Hope - Control` = hope - control,
    `Anxiety - Hope` = anxiety - hope
  ) |>
  pivot_longer(
    cols = c(`Anxiety - Control`, `Hope - Control`, `Anxiety - Hope`),
    names_to = "contrast",
    values_to = "estimate"
  ) |>
  mutate(
    model = "Age",
    subgroup = as.character(age_group)
  ) |>
  select(-age_group)

# rq2.1.3: cATE by gender
rq2.1.3.draws <- expand.grid(
  exp_condition = c("control", "anxiety", "hope"),
  gender = unique(df$gender)
) |>
  add_epred_draws(rq2.1.3, re_formula = NA) |>
  ungroup() |> 
  filter(gender != "other")

rq2.1.3.contrasts <- rq2.1.3.draws |>
  select(exp_condition, gender, .draw, .epred) |>
  pivot_wider(names_from = exp_condition, values_from = .epred) |>
  mutate(
    `Anxiety - Control` = anxiety - control,
    `Hope - Control` = hope - control,
    `Anxiety - Hope` = anxiety - hope
  ) |>
  pivot_longer(
    cols = c(`Anxiety - Control`, `Hope - Control`, `Anxiety - Hope`),
    names_to = "contrast",
    values_to = "estimate"
  ) |>
  mutate(
    model = "Gender",
    subgroup = as.character(gender)
  ) |>
  select(-gender)

# cATE by living standard
rq2.1.8.draws <- expand.grid(
  exp_condition = c("control", "anxiety", "hope"),
  living_standard = levels(rq2.1.8$data$living_standard)
) |>
  add_epred_draws(rq2.1.8, re_formula = NA) |>
  ungroup()

rq2.1.8.contrasts <- rq2.1.8.draws |>
  select(exp_condition, living_standard, .draw, .epred) |>
  pivot_wider(names_from = exp_condition, values_from = .epred) |>
  mutate(
    `Anxiety - Control` = anxiety - control,
    `Hope - Control` = hope - control,
    `Anxiety - Hope` = anxiety - hope
  ) |>
  pivot_longer(
    cols = c(`Anxiety - Control`, `Hope - Control`, `Anxiety - Hope`),
    names_to = "contrast",
    values_to = "estimate"
  ) |>
  mutate(
    model = "Living Standard",
    subgroup = as.character(living_standard)
  ) |>
  select(-living_standard)

rq2.1_posterior_data <- bind_rows(rq2.1.1.contrasts, rq2.1.2.contrasts, rq2.1.3.contrasts, rq2.1.8.contrasts) |>
  mutate(
    contrast = factor(contrast, levels = c("Anxiety - Hope", "Anxiety - Control", "Hope - Control")),
    model = factor(model, levels = c("ATE", "Age", "Gender", "Living Standard"))
  )

# Compute whether HDI excludes zero for each group
rq2.1_hdi_check <- rq2.1_posterior_data |>
  mutate(
    estimate = estimate * 100,
    subgroup = case_when(
      subgroup == "male" ~ "Men",
      subgroup == "female" ~ "Women",
      subgroup == "16-21 years" ~ "16-21",
      subgroup == "22-26 years" ~ "22-26",
      TRUE ~ subgroup
    ),
    subgroup = factor(subgroup, levels = c("ATE", "22-26", "16-21", "Women", "Men",
                                           "Comfortable", "Coping", "Difficult"))
  ) |>
  group_by(model, contrast, subgroup) |>
  summarise(excludes_zero = hdi_excludes_zero(estimate), .groups = "drop")
```

#### RQ2.1 Figure

```{r}
#| fig-height: 7
#| fig-width: 8

rq2.1_posterior_data |>
  mutate(
    estimate = estimate * 100,
    subgroup = case_when(
      subgroup == "male" ~ "Men",
      subgroup == "female" ~ "Women",
      subgroup == "16-21 years" ~ "16-21",
      subgroup == "22-26 years" ~ "22-26",
      TRUE ~ subgroup
    ),
    subgroup = factor(subgroup, levels = c("ATE", "22-26", "16-21", "Women", "Men",
                                           "Comfortable", "Coping", "Difficult"))
  ) |>
  left_join(rq2.1_hdi_check, by = c("model", "contrast", "subgroup")) |>
  ggplot(aes(x = estimate, y = subgroup, fill = excludes_zero)) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "gray40", linewidth = 0.6) +
  stat_slabinterval(
    .width = c(.95),
    point_interval = "median_hdi",
    scale = 0.7,
    slab_alpha = 0.6,        
    interval_alpha = 1,      
    point_alpha = 1,          
    normalize = "groups",
    point_size = 2.5,
    interval_size = 1.5) +
  facet_grid(model ~ contrast, scales = "free_y", space = "free_y") +
  scale_fill_manual(
    values = c("Excludes zero" = "#364B9A", "Includes zero" = "#4A7BB7"),
    name = "95% HDI",
  ) +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = seq(-10, 10, by = 5), expand = expansion(add = 2.5)) +
  coord_cartesian(xlim = c(-10, 10)) +
  labs(
    x = "Percentage Points",
    y = NULL,
    title = "Effects on Political Participation",
    subtitle = "Posterior Distributions with Median and 95% HDI"
  ) +
  theme_allround() +
  theme(
    legend.position = "bottom",
    panel.grid.major.x = element_line(color = "grey90", linewidth = 0.2)
  ) 

ggsave(here(figure_dir, "RQ2", "RQ2.1_figure.svg"), height = 7, width = 8, web_fonts = falo_svg_fonts())
```

#### RQ2.1 Item-Level Differences Figure

```{r}
df_polpart_items <- df |> 
  select(id, exp_condition, 
         exp_polpart_explain_vote,
         exp_polpart_share_story,
         exp_polpart_send_video,
         exp_polpart_discuss_online,
         exp_polpart_protest) |> 
  pivot_longer(
    cols = exp_polpart_explain_vote:exp_polpart_protest,
    names_to = "item",
    values_to = "response"
  ) |> 
  mutate(
    response_pomp = (response - 1) / (5 - 1),  # Convert 1-5 to 0-1
    item = factor(item, 
                  levels = c("exp_polpart_explain_vote",
                             "exp_polpart_share_story",
                             "exp_polpart_send_video",
                             "exp_polpart_discuss_online",
                             "exp_polpart_protest"
                            ),
                  labels = c("ExpVote", "ShareStory", "SendVideo", 
                             "DiscOnl", "Protest"))
  )
```

```{r}
# Get posterior predictions 
rq2.1.7.draws <- expand.grid(
  exp_condition = c("control", "anxiety", "hope"),
  item = levels(df_polpart_items$item)) |>
  add_epred_draws(rq2.1.7, re_formula = NA) |>
  ungroup()

# Compute item-level pairwise contrasts 
rq2.1.7.item_contrasts <- rq2.1.7.draws |>
  select(exp_condition, item, .draw, .epred) |>
  pivot_wider(names_from = exp_condition, values_from = .epred) |>
  mutate(
    `Anxiety - Control` = anxiety - control,
    `Hope - Control` = hope - control,
    `Anxiety - Hope` = anxiety - hope
  ) |>
  pivot_longer(
    cols = c(`Anxiety - Control`, `Hope - Control`, `Anxiety - Hope`),
    names_to = "contrast",
    values_to = "estimate"
  ) |>
  mutate(type = "Item-level")

# Compute pairwise comparisons across items
rq2.1.7.avg_contrasts <- rq2.1.7.item_contrasts |>
  group_by(contrast, .draw) |>
  summarise(estimate = mean(estimate), .groups = "drop") |>
  mutate(
    item = "Overall ATE",
    type = "Overall"
  )

# Combine draws
rq2.1.7.contrasts <- bind_rows(rq2.1.7.item_contrasts, rq2.1.7.avg_contrasts) |>
  mutate(
    item = factor(item, levels = c(levels(df_polpart_items$item), "Overall ATE")),
    contrast = factor(contrast, levels = c("Anxiety - Hope", "Anxiety - Control", "Hope - Control"))
  )

# Compute whether HDI excludes zero for each item
rq2.1.7.hdi_check <- rq2.1.7.contrasts |>
  mutate(estimate = estimate * 100) |>
  group_by(item, contrast) |>
  summarise(excludes_zero = hdi_excludes_zero(estimate), .groups = "drop")
```

```{r}
    term == "genderother"                                ~ "Other (vs. Men)",
    term == "exp_conditionhope:genderfemale"             ~ "Women × Hope",
    term == "exp_conditionanxiety:genderfemale"          ~ "Women × Anxiety",
    term == "exp_conditionhope:genderother"              ~ "Other × Hope",
    term == "exp_conditionanxiety:genderother"           ~ "Other × Anxiety",
    term == "living_standardCoping"                          ~ "Coping (vs. Difficult)",
    term == "living_standardComfortable"                     ~ "Comfortable (vs. Difficult)",
    term == "exp_conditionhope:living_standardCoping"        ~ "Coping × Hope",
    term == "exp_conditionanxiety:living_standardCoping"     ~ "Coping × Anxiety",
    term == "exp_conditionhope:living_standardComfortable"   ~ "Comfortable × Hope",
    term == "exp_conditionanxiety:living_standardComfortable" ~ "Comfortable × Anxiety",
    TRUE ~ term
  )) |>
  select(Parameter, Term = term, Median = estimate, MAD = std.error,
         "95% HDI Lower" = conf.low, "95% HDI Upper" = conf.high,
         "R-hat" = rhat, ESS = ess, Model)
```

```{r}
                        rq2.2.8_hu_comp, rq2.2.8_mu_comp) |>
```

#### RQ2.2 Pre-Registration Sample Table

```{r}
rq2.2.5_brms <- broom.mixed::tidy(rq2.2.5, parameters = "b", robust = TRUE, conf.method = "HPDinterval", rhat = TRUE, ess = TRUE) |>
  filter(!term %in% c("prior_b", "prior_b_hu")) |>
  mutate(
    Parameter = if_else(str_detect(term, "^b_hu_"), "hu", "mu"),
    term = str_remove(term, "^b_hu_"),
    term = str_remove(term, "^b_")
  ) |>
  mutate(term = case_when(
    term == "(Intercept)"        ~ "Intercept",
    term == "exp_conditionhope"  ~ "Hope (vs. Control)",
    term == "exp_conditionanxiety" ~ "Anxiety (vs. Control)",
    TRUE ~ term
  )) |>
  select(Parameter, Term = term, Median = estimate, MAD = std.error,
         "95% HDI Lower" = conf.low, "95% HDI Upper" = conf.high,
         "R-hat" = rhat, ESS = ess)
```

```{r}

  mutate(across(where(is.numeric), ~round(.x, 3))) |>
  tt(notes = "Note. mu = log-normal component (time spent viewing); hu = hurdle component (probability of not viewing).")

rq2.2.5_brms_table
rq2.2.5_brms_table |>
```

```{r}
# Combine all hu contrasts and add parameter indicator
rq2.2_hu_posterior_data <- bind_rows(
  rq2.2.1.hu_contrasts,
  rq2.2.2.hu_contrasts,
  rq2.2.3.hu_contrasts,
  rq2.2.8.hu_contrasts
) |>
  mutate(parameter = "hu")

# Combine all mu contrasts and add parameter indicator
rq2.2_mu_posterior_data <- bind_rows(
  rq2.2.1.mu_contrasts,
  rq2.2.2.mu_contrasts,
  rq2.2.3.mu_contrasts,
  rq2.2.8.mu_contrasts
) |>
  mutate(parameter = "mu")

# Combine both parameters
rq2.2_posterior_data <- bind_rows(
  rq2.2_hu_posterior_data,
  rq2.2_mu_posterior_data
) |>
  mutate(
    # Relabel subgroups
    subgroup = case_when(
      subgroup == "male" ~ "Men",
      subgroup == "female" ~ "Women",
      subgroup == "16-21 years" ~ "16-21",
      subgroup == "22-26 years" ~ "22-26",
      TRUE ~ subgroup
    ),
    # Set factor levels
    model = factor(model, levels = c("ATE", "Age", "Gender", "Living Standard")),
    subgroup = factor(subgroup, levels = c("ATE", "22-26", "16-21", "Women", "Men",
                                           "Comfortable", "Coping", "Difficult"))
  )

# Compute whether HDI excludes zero for each parameter separately
rq2.2_hurdle_check <- rq2.2_posterior_data |>
  group_by(parameter, model, contrast, subgroup) |>
  summarise(excludes_zero = hdi_excludes_zero(estimate), .groups = "drop")
```

#### RQ2.2 Figure

##### Decision to View

```{r}
#| fig-height: 7
#| fig-width: 9.5

rq2.2_posterior_data |>
  filter(subgroup != "Other") |> 
  filter(parameter == "hu") |>
  mutate(estimate = -estimate * 100) |>  # Flip sign and convert to percentage points
  left_join(
    filter(rq2.2_hurdle_check, parameter == "hu"),
    by = c("parameter", "model", "contrast", "subgroup")
  ) |>
  ggplot(aes(x = estimate, y = subgroup, fill = excludes_zero)) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "gray40", linewidth = 0.6) +
  stat_slabinterval(
    .width = c(.95),
    point_interval = "median_hdi",
    scale = 0.7,
    slab_alpha = 0.6,        
    interval_alpha = 1,      
    point_alpha = 1,          
    normalize = "groups",
    point_size = 2.5,
    interval_size = 1.5) +
  facet_grid(model ~ contrast, scales = "free_y", space = "free_y") +
  scale_fill_manual(
    values = c("Excludes zero" = "#364B9A", "Includes zero" = "#4A7BB7"),
    name = "95% HDI",
  ) +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = seq(-15, 15, by = 5), expand = expansion(add = 0.5)) +
  coord_cartesian(xlim = c(-25, 25)) +
  labs(
    x = "Percentage Points",
    y = NULL,
    title = "Effects on Initiation of Political Information Seeking",
    subtitle = "Posterior Distributions with Median and 95% HDI"
  ) +
  theme_allround() +
  theme(
    panel.grid.major.x = element_line(color = "grey90", linewidth = 0.2),
    legend.position = "bottom"
  )

ggsave(here(figure_dir, "RQ2", "RQ2.2_hu_ate_cate.svg"), height = 7, width = 9.5, web_fonts = falo_svg_fonts())
```

## Robustness: Age as a Continuous Variable

```{r}
rq1.1.9 <- readRDS(here(model_dir, "RQ1", "m9.rds"))
rq1.2.9 <- readRDS(here(model_dir, "RQ1", "cj9.rds"))
rq2.1.9 <- readRDS(here(model_dir, "RQ2", "m9.rds"))
rq2.2.9 <- readRDS(here(model_dir, "RQ2", "hu9.rds"))

age_note <- paste0("Age was standardised (M = ", sprintf("%.1f", mean(df$age)), ", SD = ", sprintf("%.1f", sd(df$age)),
                   " years), so coefficients involving age are per standard deviation of age.")
```

### Continuous Age: Democratic Support and Democratic Candidate Choice Table

```{r}
age_c_rq1.1_brms <- tidy(rq1.1.9, robust = TRUE, conf.method = "HPDinterval", rhat = TRUE, ess = TRUE) |>
  filter(effect == "fixed") |>
  mutate(Outcome = "Democratic Support")

age_c_rq1.2_brms <- bind_rows(
  tidy(rq1.2.9, parameters = "b",    robust = TRUE, conf.method = "HPDinterval", rhat = TRUE, ess = TRUE),
  tidy(rq1.2.9, parameters = "^sd_", robust = TRUE, conf.method = "HPDinterval", rhat = TRUE, ess = TRUE)
) |>
  filter(!term %in% conjoint_controls) |>
  mutate(term = str_remove(term, "^b_"),
         Outcome = "Democratic Candidate Choice")

age_c_rq1_brms <- bind_rows(age_c_rq1.1_brms, age_c_rq1.2_brms) |>
  mutate(term = case_when(
    term %in% c("(Intercept)", "Intercept")                                 ~ "Intercept",
    term == "exp_conditionhope"                                             ~ "Hope (vs. Control)",
    term == "exp_conditionanxiety"                                          ~ "Anxiety (vs. Control)",
    term %in% c("age_z", "participant_age_z")                               ~ "Age (z)",
    term %in% c("exp_conditionhope:age_z", "exp_conditionhope:participant_age_z")       ~ "Age × Hope",
    term %in% c("exp_conditionanxiety:age_z", "exp_conditionanxiety:participant_age_z") ~ "Age × Anxiety",
    term == "conjoint_demDemocratic"                                        ~ "Democratic (vs. Undemocratic)",
    term == "conjoint_demDemocratic:exp_conditionhope"                      ~ "Democratic × Hope",
    term == "conjoint_demDemocratic:exp_conditionanxiety"                   ~ "Democratic × Anxiety",
    term == "conjoint_demDemocratic:participant_age_z"                      ~ "Democratic × Age",
    term == "conjoint_demDemocratic:exp_conditionhope:participant_age_z"    ~ "Democratic × Hope × Age",
    term == "conjoint_demDemocratic:exp_conditionanxiety:participant_age_z" ~ "Democratic × Anxiety × Age",
    term == "sd_id__(Intercept)"                                            ~ "SD(Intercept)",
    TRUE ~ term
  )) |>
  select(Term = term, Median = estimate, MAD = std.error,
         "95% HDI Lower" = conf.low, "95% HDI Upper" = conf.high,
         "R-hat" = rhat, ESS = ess, Outcome)

n1 <- age_c_rq1_brms |> filter(Outcome == "Democratic Support") |> nrow()
```

```{r}
age_c_rq1_brms_table <- age_c_rq1_brms |>
  mutate(across(where(is.numeric), ~round(.x, 3))) |>
  select(-Outcome) |>
  tt(notes = paste("Note.", age_note,
                   "The democratic candidate choice model controls for conjoint attributes: candidate sex, age, political party, and economic reputation.")) |>
  group_tt(i = list("Democratic Support" = 1, "Democratic Candidate Choice" = n1 + 1))

age_c_rq1_brms_table
age_c_rq1_brms_table |>
  save_tt(here(table_dir, "RQ1", "age_continuous_RQ1_brms_table.docx"), overwrite = TRUE)
```

## Anxiety–Hope Dimension by Subgroup

```{r}
ah1 <- readRDS(here(model_dir, "exploratory", "ah1.rds"))
ah2 <- readRDS(here(model_dir, "exploratory", "ah2.rds"))
ah3 <- readRDS(here(model_dir, "exploratory", "ah3.rds"))
ah4 <- readRDS(here(model_dir, "exploratory", "ah4.rds"))
ah5 <- readRDS(here(model_dir, "exploratory", "ah5.rds"))
```

### Anxiety–Hope Dimension Table

```{r}
# Treatment effects overall and within each subgroup
ah1_comp_raw <- avg_comparisons(ah1, variables = list(exp_condition = "pairwise"))
ah2_comp_raw <- avg_comparisons(ah2, variables = list(exp_condition = "pairwise"), by = "age_group")
ah3_comp_raw <- avg_comparisons(ah3, variables = list(exp_condition = "pairwise"), by = "gender")
ah4_comp_raw <- avg_comparisons(ah4, variables = list(exp_condition = "pairwise"), by = "living_standard")

# Differences in treatment effects between subgroups (interactions)
ah2_diff_raw <- avg_comparisons(ah2, variables = list(exp_condition = "pairwise"), by = "age_group",
                                hypothesis = difference ~ pairwise | contrast)
ah3_diff_raw <- avg_comparisons(ah3, variables = list(exp_condition = "pairwise"), by = "gender",
                                hypothesis = difference ~ pairwise | contrast)
ah4_diff_raw <- avg_comparisons(ah4, variables = list(exp_condition = "pairwise"), by = "living_standard",
                                hypothesis = difference ~ pairwise | contrast)
ah5_diff_raw <- avg_slopes(ah5, variables = "age_z", by = "exp_condition", hypothesis = ~ pairwise)

# Associations of each moderator with the Anxiety–Hope dimension, averaged across conditions
ah2_assoc_raw <- avg_comparisons(ah2, variables = list(age_group = "pairwise"),
                                 newdata = datagrid(exp_condition = unique, age_group = unique))
ah3_assoc_raw <- avg_comparisons(ah3, variables = list(gender = "pairwise"),
                                 newdata = datagrid(exp_condition = unique, gender = unique))
ah4_assoc_raw <- avg_comparisons(ah4, variables = list(living_standard = "pairwise"),
                                 newdata = datagrid(exp_condition = unique, living_standard = unique))
ah5_assoc_raw <- avg_slopes(ah5, variables = "age_z", newdata = datagrid(exp_condition = unique))

ah_effects <- bind_rows(
  ah1_comp_raw |> as_tibble() |>
    left_join(probability_direction(ah1_comp_raw), by = "contrast") |>
    mutate(Block = "Treatment Effects: Overall", Group = "Overall"),
  ah2_comp_raw |> as_tibble() |>
    left_join(probability_direction(ah2_comp_raw, by = "age_group"), by = c("contrast", "age_group")) |>
    mutate(Block = "Treatment Effects by Age Group", Group = as.character(age_group)),
  ah3_comp_raw |> as_tibble() |>
    left_join(probability_direction(ah3_comp_raw, by = "gender"), by = c("contrast", "gender")) |>
    mutate(Block = "Treatment Effects by Gender", Group = as.character(gender)),
  ah4_comp_raw |> as_tibble() |>
    left_join(probability_direction(ah4_comp_raw, by = "living_standard"), by = c("contrast", "living_standard")) |>
    mutate(Block = "Treatment Effects by Living Standard", Group = as.character(living_standard))
)

ah_diffs <- bind_rows(
  ah2_diff_raw |> as_tibble() |>
    left_join(probability_direction(ah2_diff_raw, id = "contrast", by = "hypothesis"), by = c("contrast", "hypothesis")) |>
    mutate(Block = "Differences in Treatment Effects: Age Group"),
  ah3_diff_raw |> as_tibble() |>
    left_join(probability_direction(ah3_diff_raw, id = "contrast", by = "hypothesis"), by = c("contrast", "hypothesis")) |>
    mutate(Block = "Differences in Treatment Effects: Gender"),
  ah4_diff_raw |> as_tibble() |>
    left_join(probability_direction(ah4_diff_raw, id = "contrast", by = "hypothesis"), by = c("contrast", "hypothesis")) |>
    mutate(Block = "Differences in Treatment Effects: Living Standard")
) |>
  mutate(Group = str_remove_all(hypothesis, "[()]"))

# Continuous age: differences in age slopes between conditions, per SD of age
ah_age_diffs <- ah5_diff_raw |> as_tibble() |>
  left_join(probability_direction(ah5_diff_raw, id = "hypothesis"), by = "hypothesis") |>
  mutate(contrast = str_remove_all(hypothesis, "[()]"),
         Block = "Differences in Treatment Effects: Age (Continuous, per SD)",
         Group = "Age")

ah_assoc <- bind_rows(
  ah2_assoc_raw |> as_tibble() |>
    left_join(probability_direction(ah2_assoc_raw), by = "contrast") |>
    mutate(Block = "Association with Age Group (Averaged Across Conditions)", Group = contrast),
  ah3_assoc_raw |> as_tibble() |>
    left_join(probability_direction(ah3_assoc_raw), by = "contrast") |>
    # same order as the gender differences above
    arrange(factor(contrast, levels = c("female - male", "other - male", "other - female"))) |>
    mutate(Block = "Association with Gender (Averaged Across Conditions)", Group = contrast),
  ah4_assoc_raw |> as_tibble() |>
    left_join(probability_direction(ah4_assoc_raw), by = "contrast") |>
    mutate(Block = "Association with Living Standard (Averaged Across Conditions)", Group = contrast),
  ah5_assoc_raw |> as_tibble() |>
    left_join(probability_direction(ah5_assoc_raw), by = "contrast") |>
    mutate(Block = "Association with Age (Continuous, per SD; Averaged Across Conditions)", Group = "Age")
) |>
  mutate(contrast = "")

ah_table_data <- bind_rows(ah_effects, ah_diffs, ah_age_diffs, ah_assoc) |>
  mutate(
    Contrast = case_when(
      contrast == "anxiety - control" ~ "Anxiety - Control",
      contrast == "anxiety - hope"    ~ "Anxiety - Hope",
      contrast == "hope - control"    ~ "Hope - Control",
      TRUE ~ contrast),
    Group = Group |>
      str_replace_all("female", "Women") |>
      str_replace_all("\\bmale\\b", "Men") |>
      str_replace_all("other", "Other")
  ) |>
  select(Block, Group, Contrast,
         Median = estimate,
         "95% HDI Lower" = conf.low,
         "95% HDI Upper" = conf.high,
         "Probability of Direction" = pd)

# Row index at which each block starts
ah_blocks <- rle(ah_table_data$Block)
ah_block_starts <- setNames(as.list(cumsum(c(1, head(ah_blocks$lengths, -1)))), ah_blocks$values)
```

```{r}
ah_table <- ah_table_data |>
  mutate(across(where(is.numeric), ~round(.x, 3))) |>
  select(-Block) |>
  tt(notes = paste("Note. Anxiety–Hope dimension: 0 = maximum hopefulness, 1 = maximum anxiety.",
                   "Differences in treatment effects correspond to the interaction terms of the respective models.",
                   "Associations are differences between subgroups (age: change per SD), averaged across the three conditions.")) |>
  group_tt(i = ah_block_starts)

ah_table
ah_table |>
  save_tt(here(table_dir, "exploratory", "anxiety_hope_subgroup_table.docx"), overwrite = TRUE)
```

## Combined Figure

```{r}
# Helper to standardise subgroup labels
fix_subgroups <- function(x) {
  case_when(
    x == "female"      ~ "Women",
    x == "male"        ~ "Men",
    x == "16-21 years" ~ "16-21",
    x == "22-26 years" ~ "22-26",
    TRUE               ~ x
  )
}

# RQ1.1 — Democratic Support
rq1.1_clean <- rq1.1_posterior_data |>
  mutate(
    outcome   = "Democratic Support",
    estimate  = estimate * 100,
    subgroup  = fix_subgroups(subgroup),
    parameter = NA_character_
  ) |>
  select(.draw, contrast, estimate, model, subgroup, outcome, parameter)

# RQ1.2 — Democratic Candidate Choice
rq1.2_clean <- rq1.2_posterior_data |>
  rename(.draw = drawid) |>
  mutate(
    .draw     = as.integer(.draw),
    outcome   = "Democratic Candidate Choice",
    estimate  = estimate * 100,
    subgroup  = fix_subgroups(subgroup),
    parameter = NA_character_
  ) |>
  select(.draw, contrast, estimate, model, subgroup, outcome, parameter)

# RQ2.1 — Political Participation
rq2.1_clean <- rq2.1_posterior_data |>
  mutate(
    outcome   = "Political Participation",
    estimate  = estimate * 100,
    subgroup  = fix_subgroups(subgroup),
    parameter = NA_character_
  ) |>
  select(.draw, contrast, estimate, model, subgroup, outcome, parameter)

# RQ2.2 — Information Seeking (hu + mu)
rq2.2_clean <- rq2.2_posterior_data |>
  rename(.draw = drawid) |>
  mutate(
    .draw    = as.integer(.draw),
    subgroup = fix_subgroups(subgroup),
    outcome  = case_when(
      parameter == "hu" ~ "Interest in Democratic Involvement",
      parameter == "mu" ~ "Information Seeking (Time)"
    ),
    estimate = case_when(
      parameter == "hu" ~ -estimate * 100,
      parameter == "mu" ~ estimate
    )
  ) |>
  select(.draw, contrast, estimate, model, subgroup, outcome, parameter)

# Combine
combined_fig_data <- bind_rows(
  rq1.1_clean,
  rq1.2_clean,
  rq2.1_clean,
  rq2.2_clean
) |>
  mutate(
    outcome  = factor(outcome, levels = c(
      "Democratic Support",
      "Democratic Candidate Choice",
      "Political Participation",
      "Interest in Democratic Involvement",
      "Information Seeking (Time)"
    )),
    contrast = factor(contrast, levels = c(
      "Anxiety - Hope",
      "Anxiety - Control",
      "Hope - Control"
    )),
    subgroup = factor(subgroup, levels = c("ATE", "16-21", "22-26", "Women", "Men"))
  )
```

```{r}
combined_fig_data <- combined_fig_data |>
  filter(
    subgroup == "ATE",
    model == "ATE",
    outcome != "Information Seeking (Time)"
  ) |>
  mutate(contrast = fct_rev(contrast)) |>
  group_by(outcome, contrast) |>
  mutate(median_sign = sign(median(estimate))) |>
  ungroup()

pd_data <- combined_fig_data |>
  group_by(outcome, contrast) |>
  summarise(
    median_est = median(estimate),
    pd = mean(sign(estimate) == sign(median_est)),
    pd_label = paste0("PD = ", sprintf("%.1f", pd * 100), "%"),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |>
  mutate(contrast = fct_rev(contrast))  # match the fct_rev in the plot
```


```{r}
#| fig-height: 6
#| fig-width: 8

ggplot(combined_fig_data, aes(x = estimate, y = contrast)) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "gray40", linewidth = 0.6) +
  # Slab for positive-median groups: concordant = right of zero
  stat_slab(
    data = filter(combined_fig_data, median_sign >= 0),
    aes(fill = after_stat(ifelse(x > 0, "concordant", "discordant"))),
    alpha = 0.8,
    scale = 0.7
  ) +
  # Slab for negative-median groups: concordant = left of zero
  stat_slab(

    alpha = 0.8,

  ) +

    .width = c(0.50, 0.95),
```

## Robustness: Controlling for Demographics

ATEs from the main models compared with the same models adjusted for age (standardised), gender, ideology, education level, and living standard (Model 4 in each model script).

```{r}
rq1.1.4 <- readRDS(here(model_dir, "RQ1", "m4.rds"))
rq1.2.4 <- readRDS(here(model_dir, "RQ1", "cj4.rds"))
rq2.1.4 <- readRDS(here(model_dir, "RQ2", "m4.rds"))
rq2.2.4 <- readRDS(here(model_dir, "RQ2", "hu4.rds"))
```

```{r}
# Treatment effects averaged over the observed data, as needed for the covariate-adjusted models
comp_linear   <- function(m) avg_comparisons(m, variables = list(exp_condition = "pairwise"))
comp_conjoint <- function(m) avg_slopes(m, variables = "conjoint_dem", by = "exp_condition",
                                        re_formula = NA, hypothesis = ~pairwise)
comp_hurdle   <- function(m) avg_comparisons(m, dpar = "hu", variables = list(exp_condition = "pairwise"))

# Posterior draws of the pairwise contrasts in percentage points
# sign = -1 flips the hurdle contrasts to the probability of viewing, as in the combined figure
ate_draws <- function(obj, outcome, specification, id = "contrast", sign = 1) {
  posterior_draws(obj) |>
    as_tibble() |>
    transmute(
      drawid,
      contrast      = .data[[id]] |> str_remove_all("[()]") |> str_to_title(),
      estimate      = sign * draw * 100,
      outcome       = outcome,
      Specification = specification
    )
}

controls_draws <- bind_rows(
  ate_draws(comp_linear(rq1.1.1),   "Democratic Support", "Unadjusted"),
  ate_draws(comp_linear(rq1.1.4),   "Democratic Support", "Adjusted"),
  ate_draws(comp_conjoint(rq1.2.1), "Democratic Candidate Choice", "Unadjusted", id = "hypothesis"),
  ate_draws(comp_conjoint(rq1.2.4), "Democratic Candidate Choice", "Adjusted", id = "hypothesis"),
  ate_draws(comp_linear(rq2.1.1),   "Political Participation", "Unadjusted"),
  ate_draws(comp_linear(rq2.1.4),   "Political Participation", "Adjusted"),
  ate_draws(comp_hurdle(rq2.2.1),   "Interest in Democratic Involvement", "Unadjusted", sign = -1),
  ate_draws(comp_hurdle(rq2.2.4),   "Interest in Democratic Involvement", "Adjusted", sign = -1)
) |>
  mutate(
    outcome = factor(outcome, levels = c(
      "Democratic Support",
      "Democratic Candidate Choice",
      "Political Participation",
      "Interest in Democratic Involvement"
    )),
    contrast      = factor(contrast, levels = c("Anxiety - Hope", "Anxiety - Control", "Hope - Control")),
    Specification = factor(Specification, levels = c("Unadjusted", "Adjusted"))
  )
```

### Demographic Controls Table

```{r}
hdi_interval <- function(x, cred = 0.95) {
  # Shortest interval containing 95% of the draws (same algorithm as hdi_excludes_zero())
  x <- sort(x)
  n <- length(x)
  k <- n - floor(n * cred)
  i <- which.min(x[(n - k + 1):n] - x[1:k])
  c(x[i], x[n - k + i])
}

controls_summary <- controls_draws |>
  group_by(outcome, contrast, Specification) |>
  summarise(
    Median = median(estimate),
    lower  = hdi_interval(estimate)[1],
    upper  = hdi_interval(estimate)[2],
    PD     = (\(p) max(p, 1 - p))(mean(estimate > 0)),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |>
  mutate(HDI = sprintf("[%.2f, %.2f]", lower, upper)) |>
  select(-lower, -upper) |>
  pivot_wider(
    names_from  = Specification,
    values_from = c(Median, HDI, PD),
    names_glue  = "{Specification} {.value}"
  ) |>
  arrange(outcome, contrast) |>
  select(outcome, Contrast = contrast,
         `Unadjusted Median`, `Unadjusted 95% HDI` = `Unadjusted HDI`, `Unadjusted PD`,
         `Adjusted Median`,   `Adjusted 95% HDI`   = `Adjusted HDI`,   `Adjusted PD`)

# Row index at which each outcome starts
controls_blocks <- rle(as.character(controls_summary$outcome))
controls_block_starts <- setNames(as.list(cumsum(c(1, head(controls_blocks$lengths, -1)))), controls_blocks$values)
```

```{r}
controls_table <- controls_summary |>
  mutate(across(ends_with("Median"), ~round(.x, 2)),
         across(ends_with("PD"), ~round(.x, 3))) |>
  select(-outcome) |>
  tt(notes = paste(
    "Note. Treatment effects in percentage points (posterior median and 95% HDI); PD = probability of direction.",
    "Adjusted models control for age (standardised), gender, ideology, education level, and living standard (N = 1,895 in all models).",
    "Democratic candidate choice: difference in the effect of the democratic candidate attribute; both models also control for the conjoint attributes,",
    "and in the adjusted model each control variable is interacted with democratic behaviour.",
    "Interest in democratic involvement: probability of choosing to view the political information (hurdle component, sign reversed)."
  )) |>
  group_tt(i = controls_block_starts)

controls_table
controls_table |>
  save_tt(here(table_dir, "demographic_controls_ATE_table.docx"), overwrite = TRUE)
```
